assertions.name: the_swap_turns_one_violation_into_hundreds
assertions.note: 845 against 1. The ruling made the law one-sided for a physical reason -- every SEMF correction SUBTRACTS -- and the swap moves it INTO the data instead of above it

assertions.name: as_built_stays_below_one_in_every_band_and_swapped_does_not
assertions.note: the swapped A = 40-160 bands sit above 1

assertions.name: the_swap_halves_the_asymmetry_error_and_doubles_the_surface_error
assertions.note: error moves between channels rather than out of the law -- what a one-bit reparameterisation does, not what a missing term looks like

assertions.name: the_eigenvalues_are_plus_q_and_minus_one_over_q
assertions.note: solved from sigma^2 = h.sigma + 1, not asserted

assertions.name: the_magnitudes_do_not_corroborate_the_sign_match
assertions.note: (a) one bit agreeing with one bit happens half the time by chance; (b) in V(x)V the eigenvalue +q belongs to the SYMMETRIC part and -q^-1 to the ANTISYMMETRIC part, so the sign encodes pairing statistics, not charge. Reading it as a charge sign is a category slip. Charge does NOT pin the branch

parameters.verdict: swap NOT adopted; corpus branch stands
